title: Impulse Buying
scenario: Buying something during a sale without planning for it.
fix: Wait 24 hours before buying — if you still want it after that, go ahead.

title: Ignoring Small Expenses
scenario: Spending rs.100 daily on tea/snacks adds up to rs.3000 a month.
fix: Track even your small daily expenses.

title: Late Payments
scenario: Not paying a bill on time and getting charged a late fee.
fix: Set reminders or use auto-pay for recurring bills.

title: Unused Subscriptions
scenario: Paying for Netflix/Spotify that you barely use.

title: Spending Without a Plan
scenario: Going through the month with no budget at all.
fix: Follow the 50-30-20 rule at the start of every month.
